title: Borrower Copy Delivery Standards for Appraisal Order Reports
content:
The delivery standards for the borrower's copy of an Appraisal Order report are the same for every report type.

| Report type | Copy delivered within (business days after the completed date) | Copy delivered at least (business days before consummation, no waiver) | Borrower may waive the three-day timing | Borrower's copy free of charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Desktop Appraisal (Form 1004 Desktop) | 3 | 3 | Yes | Yes |
| Larkspur Exterior-Only Appraisal (Form 2055) | 3 | 3 | Yes | Yes |
| Larkspur Condominium Appraisal (Form 1073) | 3 | 3 | Yes | Yes |
| Larkspur Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004) | 3 | 3 | Yes | Yes |
| Larkspur FHA Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004 FHA) | 3 | 3 | Yes | Yes |
| Larkspur Small Residential Income Appraisal (Form 1025) | 3 | 3 | Yes | Yes |
| Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo) | 3 | 3 | Yes | Yes |

- **Business days after completion** — the number of business days after the date the report was completed by which the copy must be delivered to the borrower: 3.
- **Business days before consummation** — the number of business days before consummation by which the copy must be delivered when no timing waiver is signed: 3.
- **Timing waiver** — the borrower may waive the three-day delivery timing for every report type.
- **Free copy** — the borrower's copy of the report is provided free of charge for every report type.
